quotes.text: 9. Durante la semana pasada, ¿cuánto tiempo dedicó... a
2 cuidar o atender sin pago, de manera exclusiva, a niños, ancianos, enfermos o discapacitados? (bañarlos, cambiarlos)
7 realizar los quehaceres de su hogar? (lavar, planchar, preparar y servir alimentos, barrer)
4 una persona que se dedica a los quehaceres de su hogar?

assessments.reasoning: For responsibility: False. The instrument does not contain any question asking who is in charge of, plans, organizes, or is responsible for domestic or care work. Question 9 asks about time spent carrying out tasks, and Question 2e options classify non-occupational activity status, neither of which asks about managerial or mental responsibility. For performance: True. Question 9 directly asks whether individual household members performed unpaid care ('cuidar o atender sin pago, de manera exclusiva, a niños, ancianos, enfermos o discapacitados?') and domestic tasks ('realizar los quehaceres de su hogar?'). For magnitude: True. Question 9 explicitly records the time dedicated to each unpaid domestic and care activity during the previous week in hours and minutes.
